content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The final decision's Claim 1 conclusion rests solely on Complainant's failure to report the slurs before EEO contact, and the record does not show how the conflicting accounts were weighed or connected to the missing evidence (Threat Assessment Committee report, LT2's photographs, CO1's contemporaneous memo)."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"Material characterizations are not tied to source documents in the file: the Committee's finding that the assault 'could not be substantiated' comes only from CAPT's recollection after he referred the investigator to Human Resources, LT2's photos are described but not included, and CAPT's reported 'psychologically unstable' remark is never addressed by CAPT."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most events are dated (Nov. 17, 2022 incident through the Aug. 3, 2023 OWCP acceptance), but the sequence has inconsistencies: COP is described both as paid and as denied after OWCP's denial, CAPT's March 2 claim of no contact since January 2 sits uneasily with his February 9 request, and the Committee's date and outcome are given only as 'the following day' with no documented result."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who issued the final decision, does not show that the Committee documentation held by Acting HRM was obtained or that Acting HRM was interviewed, and does not document CAPT's knowledge of Complainant's EEO activity even though CAPT took several of the challenged actions; only HRM's knowledge (September 2023) is addressed."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"With the central Committee report, photographs, and witness memos absent, and the reprisal analysis lacking CAPT's knowledge of protected activity, an independent reviewer could not assess from the record alone whether the conclusions on either claim are supported."}}}
